hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Sand separator
function: The high-pressure vessel upstream of the chokes that drops proppant and debris out of the flowback stream by gravity or cyclone action, protecting the chokes and separator from erosion.

tabs.overview: Flow enters tangentially or over a baffle; solids fall to the bottom and are dumped through a valve to a sand box on a schedule; clean flow leaves the top. Two units are often run in parallel so one can be dumped while the other flows.
tabs.engineering: Rated to wellhead pressure (10,000 psi common); capacity in pounds of sand between dumps; erosion-resistant inlet.
tabs.connections: Wellhead iron in; choke manifold out; dump line to the sand box.
tabs.safety: Dumping a live vessel is a controlled operation; erosion at the inlet.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Dump frequency tracked against sand returns; sand volumes recorded.
tabs.failure_modes: Sand carryover, inlet erosion, dump valve washout.
